direction: Neighborhood grooming salon: the logo's green serif and paw, show-bow pink, bath-day cream, arched photo frames
hero_idea: Their line 'Big or small, short or tall, we groom them all!' beside a find-your-breed price finder built from their full published 186-breed price list (bath & brush / haircut)
scroll_story: Paw prints walk down the page edge one step at a time as you scroll; pinned 'spa day' section runs a clock to ~4 hours through drop-off, kennel, bath and pickup
custom_ui: Walk-in services ticket with their real prices plus cat prices; hanging shop sign with live open/closed; sideways strip of groomed pets
